spans.s: लभ् (I) vi. 1Ā (pp. लब्ध; pres. लभते) 1. To take, to take hold of, to catch; 2. to acquire, to get, लभेत सिकतासु तैलमपि यत्नतः पीडयन् Bhartr.ii.5, M.xi.123, ix.251, R.ix.17; 3. to be in possession of, to have, to possess; 4. to find, राजा लब्ध्वा निधिं दद्याद्द्विजेभ्योऽर्धम् Yaj.ii.34; 5. to be able, to be permitted, e.g. न चैनं कश्च्दारोढुं लभते राजसत्तमम् Bh.; 6. to recover, to regain; 7. to know, to understand, to learn, सत्यमलभमानः Kull. on M.viii.109.(अंतरं लभ् ‘to get a footing, to be impressed on,’ R.vi.66. चेतनां लभ् ‘to come to oneself, to recover consciousness.’ पदं लभ् ‘to take a hold on, to affect.’ सिद्धिं लभ् ‘to be accomplished.’)With आ-, 1. to touch, गावश्चालेभिरे भटैः Bt.xv.91; 2. to offer as a sacrifice, गरभं पशुमालभ्य Yaj.iii.280; 3. to obtain, to attain, श्यामं वपुरतितरां कांतिमालप्स्यते (v.l.) ते Megh.i.15.With उप-, 1. to obtain, to attain, उपलब्धवती दिवश्च्युतं विवशा शापनिवृत्तिकारणम् R.viii.82, x.2, xviii.22; 2. to perceive, to see, to see the existence of, e.g. अग्निराप्तोपदेशात्प्रतीयतेऽत्राग्निरिति । प्रत्यासीदता धूमदर्शनेनानुमीयते । प्रत्यासन्नेन च साक्षादुपलभ्यते.With उपा-, 1. to chide, to taunt, to blame, रहस्युपालभ्यत चंद्रशेखरः K.S.vi.58; 2. to know, to learn, Bt.iii.27.With प्रति-, 1. to gain, to obtain; 2. to recover, to regain.With विप्र-, 1. to deceive, to cheat; 2. to insult, to disregard; 3. to recover, to regain.With सम्-, to obtain.
लभ् Caus. (लंभयति-ते) 1. to give, to bestow; 2. to obtain, to receive; 3. to find out, to discover; 4. to cause to take; 5. to cause to suffer.
लभ् Desid. (लिप्सते) to wish to obtain, to long for.
लभन n. 1. The act of obtaining; 2. of conceiving.
लभस (I) m. 1. Wealth, riches; 2. a solicitor.
लभस (II) n. A rope for tying a horse.
लभ्य a. (f. भ्या) 1. Capable of being acqured, attainable, obtainable, प्रांशुलभ्ये फले लोभादुद्वाहुरिव वामनः R.i.3, K.S.v.18; 2. fit, proper, suitable; 3. intelligible.
लभ्य a. (f. भ्या) 1. Capable of being acqured, attainable, obtainable, प्रांशुलभ्ये फले लोभादुद्वाहुरिव वामनः R.i.3, K.S.v.18; 2. fit, proper, suitable; 3. intelligible.

लाभ m. 1. Obtaining, gaining, acquisition, अतो नृपाश्चक्षमिरे समेताः स्त्रीरत्नलाभं न तदात्मजस्य R.vii.34; 2. gain, profit, सुखदुःखो समे कृत्वा लाभालाभौ जयाजयौ Bg.ii.38, M.ii.331; 3. interest; 4. capture, conquest; 5. perception, knowledge.
